summary: Gilam Seok is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a bachelor's degree at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies and a doctorate at Dongguk University WISE Campus. He held posts in Dongguk's Department of Buddhist Studies and at Geumgang University.

Gilbert Lazard (1920–2018) was a French linguist and Iranian and Central Asian studies scholar who studied at the École Normale Supérieure. He held posts at the École Pratique des Hautes Études (~1951–1990) and the University of Paris (~1960–1980).

Gilbert Slater (1864–1938) was a scholar of Indology and history who earned a doctorate at the London School of Economics. He served as Principal of Ruskin College (1909–1915) and the first Professor of Indian Economics at the University of Madras (1915).

Gilbert Zhe Chen is a historian, Sinologist, and Buddhist studies scholar who earned his PhD from Washington University in St. Louis (2012–2019). In 2019, he became an Associate Professor at Towson University.

Gilberte de Coral-Rémusat (1903–1943) worked in Indology and archaeology. She studied at the École du Louvre (~1928–1932) and the École Pratique des Hautes Études under Jean Przyluski, Paul Pelliot, and Paul Masson-Oursel.

Gilles Tarabout is an Indologist and religious studies scholar who studied under Madeleine Biardeau. Attested in 2004, he held posts at CNRS, EHESS, and the Fondation Maison des Sciences de l'Homme as director of the Indo-French exchange program.

Gillian (Jill) R. Hart (1934–2004) was a scholar in linguistics and Indology. She studied at Reading, Lady Margaret Hall, and Oxford under Thomas Burrow, later lecturing in Classics at Aberystwyth (1960–1969) and Durham University (1969–1993).
Gin Ling Liu is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Hsing Yun and earned a PhD from the University of Hong Kong under the supervision of Jing Yin (attested 2008).

Giorgio Renato Franci (1933–2012) was an Italian scholar of Indology, linguistics, and philosophy. He studied at the University of Bologna under Luigi Heilmann from ~1952 to 1956 and later held a post there from ~1964 to 2005.

Giovanni Gentile (1875–1944) was an Italian philosopher educated at the Scuola Normale Superiore and University of Pisa. He held professorships at Palermo, Pisa, and Sapienza University of Rome, and served as president of the Italian Institute for the Middle and Far East.

Giovanni Vacca (1872–1953) was an Italian Sinologist and historian who earned his doctorate at the University of Genoa and studied at Florence. He taught Chinese at the University of Florence before serving as a professor at Sapienza University of Rome.

Giovanni Verardi (born 1947) is an archaeologist and Buddhist studies scholar educated at Allahabad, Banaras Hindu, and Gorakhpur universities. He held academic posts at Ca' Foscari, Bologna, and the University of Naples "L'Orientale," alongside visiting positions at Collège de France and Kyoto.

Girijesh Dhar Dwivedi is an Indology and philosophy scholar who earned a master's degree in Sanskrit from Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (2010–2011) and pursued a PhD at SunRise University (2019–2026).

Girindrasekhar Bose (1887–1953) was an Indian psychoanalyst educated at Presidency University, Calcutta Medical College, and the University of Calcutta. He was Professor of Experimental Psychology at Calcutta (1917–1949) and president of the Indian Psychoanalytic Society (1922–1953).

Girolamo Donati (1857–1901) was an Italian Indologist who studied under Angelo De Gubernatis. He served as conservator at the Museo Indiano (~1886–1901) and as a lecturer in Sanskrit at the University of Florence from ~1889 to 1901.

Gisbert Combaz (1869–1941) was a Belgian scholar of Sinology and art history. He earned a doctorate of law at the Université libre de Bruxelles, studied under Louis de La Vallée Poussin, and held professorships at the Université Nouvelle and Académie Royale des Beaux-Arts.

Gisela Emma Full is a scholar in Buddhist studies and philosophy who studied at the universities of Würzburg and Münster. Attested in 2013, she held research fellow posts at European University Viadrina and the Samueli Institute.

Gisela Freund (1920–2023) was an archaeologist who studied at the German University of Prague (~1939–1944). She served as Head of the Department of Prehistory at the University of Erlangen-Nuremberg from ~1974 to 1987.

Gisho Nakano (1891–1977) was an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Junjirō Takakusu at Tokyo and earned a doctorate from Kyushu. He held multiple professorships and presidencies at Koyasan University, and taught at Peking University.
Giti Dutt is an archaeology and history researcher who studied as a PhD student at the Australian National University under doctoral supervisor Assa Doron (attested 2026).
